title: Cambridge IELTS 21 Academic Speaking Test 1 (Online Test)

parts.title: Part 1 — Introduction and interview
parts.instructions: The examiner will ask general questions about yourself and a few familiar topics. Answer naturally and try to extend each answer with a reason or example. This part lasts 4–5 minutes.

questions.question: Where do you go to get a haircut?
Would you ever change the colour of your hair?
Do you enjoy going to the hairdresser/barber?

parts.title: Part 2 — Individual long turn
parts.instructions: You will be given a topic card. You have one minute to prepare and may make notes. Then speak for one to two minutes. Try to keep talking until the examiner stops you.
parts.cue_card_topic: Describe a time when you used information for tourists, for example from a guidebook or online.
cue_card_bullets: what place this information was about
and explain whether this information was very helpful for you

parts.title: Part 3 — Two-way discussion
parts.instructions: The examiner will ask further questions connected to the Part 2 topic. These are more abstract and require you to explain, compare, and speculate. Try to give extended, well-reasoned answers. This part lasts 4–5 minutes.

questions.question: What are the most popular kinds of holidays for people from your country to go on?
Do you think most people prefer to have a holiday abroad rather than in their own country?
Why do some people want to do absolutely nothing when they go away on holiday?
What are the kinds of tourist attraction that visitors to your country like to see?
Do you think tourist attractions such as museums should be free for local people to visit?
What can make a tourist attraction disappointing for visitors?
